syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: SpaceXAI was [subpoenaed]. / On 16 October, it came.
text.ja: SpaceXAIは [召喚]された。 / 10月16日、 出席した。

captions.source: Subpoenaed 28 Sept 2026 (council press 2026/09/28/3266); threatened with a petition to a judge, it agreed on 13 Oct to testify (council 2026/10/13/3295; CNBC 13 Oct); testified 16 Oct at the Committee on Technology (amNY, CNBC, Fox live, NY Daily News, PIX11, Crain's, EFE, NY1, council 2026/10/16/3301).

text.en: By [video]. It sent / a government-affairs manager.
text.ja: [ビデオ] 出演。 / 来たのは 渉外担当の マネージャー。

captions.source: Appeared by video: CNBC ('appeared by video'), EFE ('por videoconferencia'), NY Daily News ('testified virtually'). Title: senior manager of global government affairs (amNY, council, Fox, PIX); every outlet agrees on a government-affairs manager. The monitor in the chair is staging: no outlet says what stood at the table.

text.en: Its catastrophe insurance? / The manager was "not aware / of the [specifics]".
text.ja: 大惨事への 保険は？ / 「[詳細は] 承知して いない」

captions.source: Asked whether the company carries catastrophic-risk insurance: "I'm not aware of the specifics of our insurance policies and what we have and we don't" (Fox live, verbatim); amNY reports the same answer. Quoted: the fragment 'not aware of the specifics'.

text.en: If its AI causes a death? / "We're responsible for / following the [law]."
text.fi: Jos sen tekoäly aiheuttaa kuoleman? / "Olemme vastuussa / [lain] noudattamisesta."
text.ja: AIが 死亡事故を 起こしたら？ / 「我々には [法律を] 守る 責任が ある」

captions.source: Asked whether the company would accept responsibility if its AI caused injury, physical damage or death: "We're responsible for following the law." amNY and Fox live agree.

text.en: How many work on safety? / "[Everybody] is in charge / of safety."
text.ja: 安全担当は 何人？ / 「[全員が] 安全の 責任者」

captions.source: Asked how many staff work on AI safety: "everybody is in charge of safety" (NY Daily News, La Voce di New York). She later agreed to get the council a number (NYDN, amNY). The company's side, shown on the screen in shot 2: safety is "core" (amNY, council).

text.ja: 大惨事の 確率： / [数字は] 示されず。

captions.source: No outlet reports any probability or number from the company (amNY, CNBC, Fox, NYDN, MLex). Not 'refused': no outlet reports the 5 Oct question being put to it directly. On 5 Oct none of the four companies gave one either, Anthropic included.

text.en: Everybody is in charge of safety. / The [headcount] will follow.
text.ja: 全員が 安全の 責任者。 / [人数は] 後日 連絡。

captions.source: The station's line. She agreed to send the council a safety-staff number (NYDN, amNY); MLex: the staffing question 'went unanswered'.

plate.why: the company's name on its nameplate, as in Committee of the Whole

screen.why: the video tile's lower third: the company's own side, in its own word (amNY, council)

dial.en: ODDS OF CATASTROPHE · THE COMPANY'S NUMBER

post.en: Subpoenaed, SpaceXAI came to New York's City Council: by video. Odds of catastrophe? No number. Who's in charge of safety? Everybody. #AI #AIsafety #NYC
post.fi: Haasteen saanut SpaceXAI tuli New Yorkin kaupunginvaltuustoon: videolla. Katastrofin todennäköisyys? Ei lukua. Kuka vastaa turvallisuudesta? Kaikki.
post.ja: 召喚されたSpaceXAIはニューヨーク市議会に出席した。ビデオで。大惨事の確率は？数字なし。安全の責任者は？全員。
